verdict.rationale: The documented Identity check types are document verification, selfie matching, SSN validation and id_number (name, DOB, national ID). Nothing in the pack shows phone, email or device risk signals such as carrier checks, address history or device fingerprinting offered as Identity check types. The axis applies to an identity-verification product, so the absence of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can enrich verifications with phone, email, and device risk signals — carrier checks, address history, device fingerprint — as additional documented check types
